facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George says about 1,400 of the 2,016 community network sites under the Rural Telephony Project carry active subscriber traffic.
The Ghana Investment Fund for Electronic Communications allocated GH¢30 million in its current budget, including a tranche for remedial engineering on distressed sites.
facts.system: Ghana Investment Fund for Electronic Communications

GHA.note: Gives no price of mobile data.
Gives no rural electricity access figure.
